name: Cameron
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Cameron, TX 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Cameron and Milam County, TX for 2026: the Cameron parade and fireworks, Charlie Brown Christmas, Rockdale and Thorndale.
lede: Cameron, the Milam County seat, brings out a lighted parade and fireworks on the downtown square, and nearby Rockdale and Thorndale hold their own parades the first Saturday of December.
celebrates: Cameron celebrates Christmas in Historic Downtown Cameron with the Cameron Chamber of Commerce's Christmas Parade, Festival and Fireworks, a vendor night that ends with fireworks over the square. A week later the Milam Community Theater stages A Charlie Brown Christmas at the Williams Civic Center, and the chamber and Cameron Rotary hold an annual S'more Christmas night with a children's mini parade for kids on decorated bikes and wagons. Milam County towns share the season: Thorndale and Rockdale both hold parades on the first Saturday of December, and Rockdale adds Winter Wonderland at Wolf Park.
lastyear: Last December the Cameron Christmas Parade, Festival and Fireworks was held on Thursday, December 4, 2025, from 5 pm, and the chamber's S'more Christmas and Children's Mini Parade followed on Saturday, December 13, 2025, with Rotary and photos with Santa. Rockdale and Thorndale held their own parades, and the Milam Community Theater added a youth production this year.
facts: Cameron is the seat of Milam County, and its Old Town Cameron district and The Venue at Railfan host an annual train show each April with a model train layout by the town's Jr. Engineers. The chamber's parade is co-hosted by EBCO General Contractors, which also sponsors the fireworks. The Milam Community Theater performs at the Lester and Beatrice Williams Civic Center at 408 South Columbus Avenue.
trains: Cameron has a railroad story. The Venue at Railfan in Old Town Cameron hosts the Cameron Train Show every April, and the town's Jr. Engineers run a model train layout. For Christmas trains, Rockdale's Winter Wonderland at Wolf Park is listed by local radio with train rides on December 5. Bigger holiday rail rides are on our Killeen and Temple pages, including Santa at the Depot at the Temple Railroad and Heritage Museum.
traditions: The chamber's downtown parade, festival and fireworks, themed Wrapped in Christmas Spirit.
Cameron Rotary and the chamber host free s'mores and a children's mini parade for kids 12 and under on decorated bikes and wagons.
The Milam Community Theater's youth production at the Williams Civic Center.
Kids' activities, vendors and a Hometown Christmas Parade at Wolf Park.
A 1 pm downtown parade hosted by the Thorndale Area Chamber of Commerce.
kidfact: Cameron's Jr. Engineers build a model train layout, and Cameron lights up its sky with fireworks after the Christmas parade.
faq: When is the Cameron Christmas Parade in 2026?
Thursday, December 3, 2026. Festivities begin at 5 pm in Historic Downtown Cameron, the parade begins at 6:30 pm and fireworks follow.
What else is there for kids in Cameron at Christmas?
The Milam Community Theater performs A Charlie Brown Christmas on December 12 and 13, and the chamber and Rotary host a S'more Christmas night with a children's mini parade on December 12.
Are there Christmas parades near Cameron?
Yes. Thorndale holds its parade at 1 pm on Saturday, December 5, and Rockdale holds Winter Wonderland and its Hometown Christmas Parade the same evening at Wolf Park.
Santa rides in the Cameron Christmas Parade on December 3. The chamber says Santa will take photos at the S'more Christmas night on December 12.
Is there more to do near Cameron?
Cameron families also drive to Temple and Killeen for trains, parades and lights. Those towns have their own Rally pages.
